Reference design (naive):

- FIFO: list of packets (append at end, pop front, remove by identity).
- PIFO: sorted list by (rank, ordinal).
- lag: store lag per packet directly; on service: for all live packets with rank < served.rank: lag += 1. rank_error = count of live (excluding served) with rank < served.rank.
- live set: dict id -> (pkt, bank, stage).
- samples, repartition, save/restore via deepcopy.

This is O(n) per service — fine for small fuzz cases.
